gates.name: site check
gates.reason: Cannot run on this host. site/src/play/browser/visual-baseline.browser.test.tsx compares platform-specific screenshots, and only chromium-linux and chromium-win32 baselines are committed — on macOS the first run writes 16 chromium-darwin baselines and reports all 16 as failures, then passes on any subsequent run against the baselines it just wrote. The 16 stray untracked PNGs that produced were deleted; nothing was committed. The 36 non-visual tests in the suite did pass. The answer comes from CI: docs-ci.yml's 'Build and verify landing page' step runs this on Alpine with chromium, and both 'Documentation links and terminology' and 'Verify Documentation Build' pass on this PR.

gates.name: production docs build
gates.reason: docs.ps1 is not present in this checkout. It is generated by Invoke-SetupDocs rather than committed (CLAUDE.md, Docs Site), so ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly cannot be invoked here. Docker is up, so this is the missing script alone. The answer comes from CI: the 'Verify Documentation Build' required check passes on this PR.

gates.name: host tests
gates.reason: dotnet restore fails with NU1301 / 401 Unauthorized fetching SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from nuget.pkg.github.com. That package is published from the sibling SubZeroDev.Platform repository and needs a cross-repo read:packages credential this machine does not hold — host-image.yml documents the same requirement for CI. No test ever executed, so there is no pass or fail to report.

gates.name: host image smoke
gates.reason: Blocked by the same missing cross-repo read:packages credential as host tests — the image build begins with the SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting NuGet restore. The answer comes from CI: 'Build, run, and smoke the image' passes on this PR in 2m16s.
